result_gate: No submission inspection or execution until Main notification, attempts/v_2.exit.json exists, and v_2.evaluation.json explicitly reports valid and passed.
on_v2_failure: not_needed; hard task retained; do not inspect source or search
selection: Reuse only ratchet_1 physical cases. Replay stationary generation-1 cold-champion starts whose independently checked energy exceeds a preexisting attained witness by at least 0.5. Preserve all other cases as unlaunched coverage evidence.
ordering: Round-robin original scientific families; descending preexisting gap within family, then case ID.
witness_policy: Freeze best feasible preexisting ratchet_1 field before any v2 inspection. No new witness optimization, formula reference, or global-optimum claim.
baseline_policy: For a possible proposal, provide the best actual unchanged A2 output from broad replay and one warm-discovery run as the exact initial state. Freeze before two independent warm replays; do not chain these repeats or lower W afterward.
proposal_policy: Only stable topologically distinct gaps with negligible polish explanation and two low-load resource-valid repeats can enter a private generation-3 proposal. Keep real family labels/cardinality, no forced balance. No installation or fresh launch.
solvability_policy: A generation-3 proposal has proposed_solvability_unknown unless a separate executable is actually qualified under that future target. Preexisting witness fields alone do not establish this.
load_policy: Insufficient low-load controls are resource_inconclusive, never proof of a hard scientific gap or proof of robust solution. No busy polling for v2 results; Main invokes once notified.
